tools.name: create_report
tools.description: Build a new audience report from a natural-language description. Returns a report_id and an initial status.

tools.name: get_report_status
tools.description: Check whether an in-progress report is ready. Used by clients to poll after create_report.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: List the audience reports tied to your account.

tools.name: get_demographics
tools.description: Age, gender, seniority, company size, salary, and location breakdowns.

tools.name: get_tam
tools.description: Total addressable market — the estimated size of the audience.

tools.name: get_bio_keywords
tools.description: The words your audience uses to describe themselves in their bios.

tools.name: get_social
tools.description: Social accounts your audience follows and engages with.

tools.name: get_networks
tools.description: Which social networks the audience is most active on.

tools.name: get_press
tools.description: Publications and press outlets your audience trusts.

tools.name: get_new_podcasts
tools.description: Podcasts your audience subscribes to and downloads.

tools.name: get_apps
tools.description: Mobile and desktop apps your audience uses.

tools.name: get_prompts
tools.description: Prompts your audience uses when talking to AI tools.
